description: Verify that TCP in TIME-WAIT returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of UNACCEPTABLE_11/_12 for TIME-WAIT (active-close + ACK of peer FIN).

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each: handshake → CLOSE → FW1 → tester ACK + FIN → DUT TIME-WAIT. Then tester injects OTW-SEQ / unacc-ACK. DUT corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce corrective ACKs.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: handshake / DUT FIN / tester FIN ACK / probe ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked in TIME-WAIT (OTW + unacc) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 1
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in TIME-WAIT
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 2
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to unacceptable ACK in TIME-WAIT
